1199: isai: every word about him, even his name -> anything I hear about him; 'even his name' was added, and isai can mean praise or word
1200: vaazhiya: Bless you -> Long live you; 'bless you' sounds like a reply to a sneeze
1221: maalaiyo allai: you are not a gentle evening -> you are not really evening at all; 'gentle' was added
1222: vaazhi: Bless you -> Long live you; same reason as 1200
1223: thuni arumbi: makes me feel tired of living -> my distress begins to grow; thuni = distress/aversion budding, 'tired of living' was too strong; pani arumbi kept as dew forming
1241: enaiththondrum: that nothing else can cure -> any kind at all; the Tamil asks for any medicine, 'nothing else can cure' was added
1246: pulandhu / kalandhu unarththum: ends our quarrels with a hug -> ends our sulking by holding us close; uudal/pulavi is sulking, not quarrelling
1251: naan: bolt of shyness -> bolt of modesty
1272: pen niraindha neermai: womanly shyness that is even greater than her beauty -> full of a deep womanly modesty; 'shyness' too narrow and the comparison with beauty is not in the Tamil (peridhu = very great)
1293: kettaar: people in trouble -> people who are ruined; kedu = ruin, 'trouble' too weak
1297: maanaa: has no pride -> has no dignity; naan: shyness -> modesty
1305: pulattakai: loving little anger -> sulking; pulavi is sulking, not anger
1306: thuni / pulavi: big quarrels and small sulks -> deep sulks and light sulks; both are grades of sulking
